sentinels.purpose: ZERO governed reads, ZERO authenticated provider operations, ZERO real provider values in this lane. Every provider response is the fake world.

Synthetic repo-shaped values and inventories (up to 9,900 repositories) are assembled at runtime; none is a committed literal. Non-matching repository names, descriptions and URLs must appear in NO record.

positive_controls.description: Exact id/name/owner/full_name/type binding: the pending V-R2.S2 record is replaced by a validated record adjudicated EXPECTED_PROVIDER_IDENTIFIER; the G-R5 witness record carries only id and owner.login; pagination runs to the empty page in order.
Full governed phase with a deferred finding: G-R5 runs after the V-R2 inventory and before V-R1; the bundle has exactly 9 read classes and only validated records.
Without a deferred finding, G-R5 is not executed and the bundle records it NOT_REQUIRED.
Bounded memory: 9,900 repositories retain exactly the target set and one matched identity.
The real dn0ConfigFor binds five events; the delta-recert path is derived from the candidate and permitted as a post-certification addition.
The evidence re-scan explains an adjudicated same-run value at both levels and nothing else.

negative_controls.description: Wrong id, name, owner, full_name, case differences, duplicate and zero matches all STOP with their witness tokens.
401, 403, 429, timeout, malformed JSON / page / item, oversized page, page loop, page cap and a truncated traversal all STOP.

Non-github link.type, non-numeric or zero repoId, missing org, another detector on link.repo (token prefix, userinfo) and the same value at projects[*].name STOP at once with the certified diagnostic, and G-R5 never runs.

Request safety: every G-R5 argv is exactly the page request; the builder ignores repo / org / repoId / q and refuses malformed pages; the guard refuses a repo name, org, repoId path, owner/name path or search.
G-R5 is refused without a pending adjudication, out of order and after completion.
Cross-run: a completed witness in one execution gives another nothing; a fresh witness cannot be satisfied without its own pages; targets cannot be added mid-traversal.
TI-2: owner/name link.repo, a foreign org, a repoId other than G-R1's, a string repoId and a non-github type each STOP V-R1.
RC-9a: a credential without the repo scope STOPs before any read.
Evidence re-scan: no marker, marker without a same-run value, the value at another path and a marker on another op are all unexplained.
Neither fixed historical recert can stand in for the delta recert of a later candidate.

mutation_controls.description: Repo name / org / repoId sent to GitHub (W01-W03) must be KILLED.
Raw page persisted, inventory accumulated, early pagination stop, duplicate or zero match ignored (W04-W08) must be KILLED.
Id binding by name, name / owner / full_name / type checks skipped, non-github deferral (W09-W14) must be KILLED.
Witness or adjudicated values shared across runs, hard-coded identity (W15-W17) must be KILLED.

OPAQUE_HIGH_ENTROPY suppressed globally, every detector suppressed on link.repo, 403 / 429 treated as success, projection broadened, another read class added, pending record validated early (W18-W24) must be KILLED.
TI-2 reverted or unenforced, RC-9a repo scope dropped, evidence re-scan marker or same-run check dropped, delta-recert path fixed, loop detection or page cap removed (W25-W32) must be KILLED.
Every earlier production mutant (M, N, D) re-killed on this tree; the battery still FAILS on a real survivor (self-test).
